node.statement: Each X in {A^dagger,A bold-dot B} therefore has a right inverse and ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<40e<2t (if e=0, use 0<2t). Thus X belongs to calU_t. The inner inclusion calU_t subseteq S_delta from lem-stage1-polar-retraction applies, so X=u_delta(X) bold-dot h_delta(X), with u_delta(X) in calU, h_delta(X) Hermitian, and ||h_delta(X)-J||<delta.
